blocks.html: Convolutional neural network is ready, F1 score calculated and ROC curve drawn. So you have a model. This tale is about what happens next: when and how to cleanse the model, how do push it into production and what defines quality for the model. I will show it using one of the projects we deployed here at AirHelp. I will also try to show a few tips & tricks that helps me manage Machine Learning projects.
